question: A ritual bath named as “Shahi Snan” is a major event of which of the following festival?
solution:
The correct answer is **Kumbh Mela**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Kumbh Mela is a major festival and pilgrimage in Hinduism.
 
• The festival Kumbh is celebrated in a cycle of approximately 12 years at four river-bank pilgrimage sites.
 
• The sites are
 
 
• Prayagraj (Ganges-Yamuna Sarasvati rivers confluence)
 
• Nashik (Godavari)
 
• Haridwar (Ganges)
 
• Ujjain (Shipra)
 
 
 
• Approximately 30and 50 million people attended Maha Kumbh Mela in 2013 and the Allahabad Ardh Kumbh Mela in 2019.
 
• On Amavasya, the most cherished day for bathing the pilgrims welcome and wait for the thirteen sadhu akharas to bathe first.
 
• This Programme is called shahi snan or raj yogi snan.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__​**Holi:**

 
• Holi is a popular ancient Indian festival, also known as the "Festival of Love", the "Festival of Colours" and the "Festival of Spring". 
 
• The festival celebrates the eternal and divine love of Radha Krishna.
 
• It is celebrated every year on the day after the full moon in the Hindu month of Phalgun which is early March.
 
• 
 Holi Celebrations in the different states of India

 
 
 
• Rang Panchami – Maharashtra.

 
 
• In Maharashtra, Holi is also known as Shigma or Rang Panchami (colour on the fifth)
 
 
 
• Holla Mohalla- Punjab
 
• Shigmo- Goa
 
• Royal Holi- Udaipur
 
• Kumaoni Holi - Uttarakhand
 
• Manjal Kuli- Kerala
 
 
 

1b
